issue.title: New settings page listing upcoming booking reminders
issue.body:
Harness test (new screen). Add a new page under Settings where users see the reminder emails scheduled for their upcoming bookings (booking title, attendee, send time), read-only. Empty state when there are none.

Details from @lucasgrocha (comment 6756289657):
1. Compute the send time with a fixed rule: 24 hours before the booking start. No new scheduler or schema change.
2. Organizer only: bookings where the user is the host.

pm.summary: New read-only Settings page listing reminder emails for the host's upcoming bookings, send time fixed at 24h before start. This is a new screen, so it goes to the Designer next.
acceptance_criteria: A new page is reachable from the Settings navigation, with a clear title such as 'Booking reminders'.
The page lists one row per upcoming booking where the logged-in user is the organizer/host, showing booking title, attendee, and send time.
Send time equals the booking start time minus exactly 24 hours, shown in the user's timezone and locale format.
Bookings where the user is only an attendee are not listed.
Cancelled, rejected and past bookings are not listed.
Reminders whose computed send time is already in the past are still listed only if the booking is upcoming (decision: show them as is, no special state).
Rows are ordered by send time ascending.
When there are no matching bookings, an empty state with explanatory text is shown.
The page is read-only: no buttons or forms to edit, send or cancel reminders.
A logged-out user cannot access the page or its data; one user never sees another user's bookings.
No scheduler, database schema or migration changes are introduced.
All user-visible strings are in the English locale file.
Tests cover the 24h computation, host-only filtering and the empty state.
